title: The Forecast Reliability Team · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short report (120-150 words) for your community center. Describe a simple system to check the reliability of local forecasts. Use first and second conditionals and at least two suggestions (should, recommend, suggest).
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
